text.title: 水边的比赛通知
text.situation:
星期六，利奥带玛雅在河边观察区观看划船赛。俱乐部通知介绍队伍与预定开始时间。一项良好训练成绩让期待大涨，但大雨预报使预售票销量骤降，活动最终仍照常举行。教练说经常练习可能带来更好的表现，不保证胜利。附近有指导人员组织的游泳活动中，一名有经验的游泳者在教练发出约定信号后跃入水中。“他一下就跃进水里了。”玛雅说完，又回头看赛艇队。成绩板在示意训练例子中显示一队完成时间显著改善。比赛给获胜队伍带来荣耀，利奥也看其他队如何完成赛程。俱乐部屋内，一则旧标题把鲁莽特技表演者称为 daredevil。玛雅把这一描述与外面的组织活动分开，冒不必要风险并不是教练想教的事。

俱乐部展示
经常训练可能带来更好的表现；示意用时显示明显改善，不保证比赛结果。划船赛与有指导人员的游泳活动各有组织者。旧 daredevil 标题是历史材料，不是给参加者的行动指导。

玛雅：训练后期待大涨，但游泳者跃入水中。
利奥：这是不同动作，一个是期待上升，另一个是突然入水。
玛雅：那队用时显著改善。
利奥：对，在训练例子里。今天比赛的荣耀属于实际获胜队。

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Leo took Maya to watch a boat race from the riverside viewing area. The club's notice described the teams and the scheduled start. Expectations had soared after a strong training result, but advance ticket sales plunged when heavy rain was forecast. The event eventually went ahead. The coach said regular practice could lead to better performance without guaranteeing victory. At the nearby supervised swimming session, an experienced swimmer plunged into the water when the instructor gave the agreed signal. 'He plunged straight in,' Maya said, then turned back to watch the crews. A results board showed that one crew's finishing time had improved dramatically in the club's illustrative training example. The race itself brought glory to the winning team, but Leo also watched how the other crews completed the course. Inside the clubhouse, an old headline called a reckless stunt performer a daredevil. Maya kept that description separate from the organised activities outside; taking unnecessary risks was not the lesson the coach wanted to teach.

Regular training can lead to better performance; the illustrative times show a dramatic improvement, not a guaranteed race result. The boat race and supervised swimming session have separate organisers. The old daredevil headline is an archive item, not an instruction for participants.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Expectations soared after training, but the swimmer plunged into the water.
Leo: Those describe different movements: one is an increase in expectations, the other is entering the water suddenly.
Maya: The crew's time improved dramatically.
Leo: Yes, in the training example. Today's glory goes to the winner of the actual race.

S17.V38.P01.cue: 描述活动和训练带来的期待。
acceptableAnswers: 我们去看划船赛。训练后期待大涨，但预报有雨时，预售票销量骤降。

S17.V38.P02.cue: 区分游泳动作和成绩变化。
acceptableAnswers: 游泳者跃入水中。另一方面，船队完成时间显著改善。

S17.V38.P03.cue: 向新队员说明训练与获胜的关系。
acceptableAnswers: 练习可能带来更好的表现，但不保证每场比赛的荣耀。鲁莽冒险不能代替训练。

S17.V38.T01.cue: 考试练习成绩显著改善，写一句不保证正式考试结果的总结。
acceptableAnswers: 我的练习分数显著改善。经常练习可能带来更好的表现，但正式考试结果仍不确定。
